description: Figure 5 illustrates the evaluation of Enhanced GCG across different tasks, specifically MCQ Eval, Corpora Unlearn, Corpora Release, and RMU. The horizontal axis represents these four tasks, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.7, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Four bars are presented for each task, representing different evaluation settings: MCQ Eval (green), Corpora Unlearn (blue), Corpora Release (orange), and RMU (purple). For the “MCQ Eval” task, the bars have approximate heights of 0.644, 0.539, 0.299, and 0.263, respectively. For “Corpora Unlearn”, the bars reach approximately 0.644, 0.539, 0.299, and 0.106. The “Corpora Release” task shows bars of approximately 0.507, 0.444, 0.299, and 0.088. Finally, the “RMU” task has bars reaching approximately 0.307, 0.299, 0.106, and 0.088. The bars are grouped by task, with each group containing one bar for each evaluation setting. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
